'''GoCorp''' was a vehicle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer headquartered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Their products were not often sold outside of the borders of the Corporate Sector, with the exception of the [[Metrocab Robo-Hack Landspeeder]] which the company built in conjunction with their subsidiary, [[Utilitech/Legends|Utilitech]].<ref name="EGTD" />

They were known as the one-time employer of [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]], a competent [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]] but also a flawed and sadistic taskmaster. Under her command, the remote [[GoCorp repulsor plant]] achieved soaring production levels; however, this feat was only reached through massive overwork of her [[Droid/Legends|droid]] minions.
